final_message:
I fixed the subtraction branch in `src/rpn.py` so it returns `a - b` instead of `b - a`. `apply_op('-', 5, 3)` now gives `2`. I haven't run the code or any tests.

The same fix applies to `evaluate`. It pops the right operand into `b` and the left into `a`, so `"5 3 -"` was also returning `-2` and now returns `2`. Division already used `a / b`, so it didn't need changing.
